e.summary_hk: 自述全球最大保險科技社群：新聞與洞察 + 歐洲/美國/亞洲三大會議與線上研討會
e.body: Insurtech Insights（`insurtechinsights.com`）自述为**「全球最大的保险科技社群（World’s Largest Insurtech Community）」**，是可核实的行业媒体 + 会议平台组合：**News & Insights（新闻与洞察）**、**Conferences（会议：Europe / USA / Asia 三大区域）**、**Webinars（线上研讨会）**。对 RIAA：它同时覆盖了行业信息的两个来源——**内容（新闻与洞察）**与**人脉（会议）**，而香港/亚洲学生更应关注其 **Asia** 会议线，这是区域内接触保险科技公司与从业者的实际场合；与 [[insurtech100]]（谁最强）、[[fintech-global]]（谁在拿钱）构成「**人 / 钱 / 场**」三件套，并与区域行业刊物 [[asia-insurance-review]]、[[insuranceasia-news]] 形成「泛行业 vs 保险科技专门」的分工；具体公司样本见 [[tractable]]、[[akur8]]、[[zestyai]]、[[socotra]]；行业组织与人脉轴另见 [[industry-cpd]]；适合作行业活动参与、人脉拓展与保险科技趋势跟踪。
e.body_en: Insurtech Insights (`insurtechinsights.com`) describes itself as the **"World’s Largest Insurtech Community"**, and is verifiably a combination of industry media and conference platform: **News & Insights**, **Conferences (Europe / USA / Asia)** and **Webinars**. For RIAA: it covers both sources of industry information at once — **content (news and insights)** and **network (conferences)** — and Hong Kong/Asia-based students should focus on its **Asia** conference line, a practical venue for meeting InsurTech companies and practitioners in the region; with [[insurtech100]] (who is strongest) and [[fintech-global]] (who is raising money) it forms a "**people / money / venue**" trio, and divides labour with the regional trade titles [[asia-insurance-review]] and [[insuranceasia-news]] as "general industry vs InsurTech-specific"; concrete company samples include [[tractable]], [[akur8]], [[zestyai]] and [[socotra]]; for the industry-organisation and networking axis see also [[industry-cpd]]; suits attending industry events, network building and tracking InsurTech trends.
e.body_hk: Insurtech Insights（`insurtechinsights.com`）自述為**「全球最大的保險科技社群（World’s Largest Insurtech Community）」**，是可核實的行業媒體 + 會議平台組合：**News & Insights**、**Conferences（Europe / USA / Asia 三大區域）**、**Webinars**。對 RIAA：它同時覆蓋了行業資訊的兩個來源——**內容**與**人脈**，而香港/亞洲學生更應關注其 **Asia** 會議線，這是區域內接觸保險科技公司與從業者的實際場合；與 [[insurtech100]]（誰最強）、[[fintech-global]]（誰在拿錢）構成「**人 / 錢 / 場**」三件套，並與區域行業刊物 [[asia-insurance-review]]、[[insuranceasia-news]] 形成「泛行業 vs 保險科技專門」的分工；具體公司樣本見 [[tractable]]、[[akur8]]、[[zestyai]]、[[socotra]]；行業組織與人脈軸另見 [[industry-cpd]]；適合作行業活動參與、人脈拓展與保險科技趨勢跟蹤。
